commands.name: bench

options.name: --actors
options.description: How many actors to spread the messages over. Default  8.

options.name: --messages
options.description: Messages to send. Default 1000000.

options.name: --senders
options.description: Concurrent sending tasks. Default: one per core.

options.name: --warmup
options.description: Messages to send before timing, to let the JIT settle. Default 50000.

commands.description: Measure local message throughput, counting only messages  actually handled.

commands.name: cluster

options.name: --advertised-host
options.description: Address peers should dial, when that differs from  --host. Needed when binding 0.0.0.0.

options.name: --advertised-port
options.description: Port peers should dial, when that differs from --port. Needed behind a published container port.

options.name: --cluster
options.description: Join a cluster with no seeds of its own - what the  first node of a cluster needs, since it has nobody to join.

options.name: --data
options.description: Persist state and events under this directory instead  of in memory, so they survive a restart.

options.name: --host
options.description: Address to bind. Default 127.0.0.1.

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Deactivate an actor after this many seconds without  messages. Default 300.

options.name: --node-id
options.description: This node's identity in the cluster. Defaults to  a name derived from the machine and process.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to bind. 0 picks a free one. Default 9000.

options.name: --quorum
options.description: Members a side must see to survive, for --split-brain  static-quorum. Set it above half the intended cluster size.

options.name: --secret
options.description: Shared secret every node must know. Turns on a  challenge-response handshake; the secret itself is never sent.

options.name: --seed
options.description: A cluster seed to join. Repeat for several. Supplying  any seed turns clustering on.

options.name: --split-brain
options.description: What to do when only part of the cluster is reachable: none, keep-majority, or static-quorum. Default none - both halves keep  serving.

options.name: --tls-cert
options.description: PKCS#12 (.pfx) certificate to serve. Turns on TLS  between nodes; every node must agree.

options.name: --tls-password
options.description: Password for the certificate file, if it has one.

options.name: --tls-pin
options.description: Accept only this certificate thumbprint from peers.  Without it, peers must present a certificate the machine already trusts.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log the runtime's own activity at debug level.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Keep printing the member table as it changes.

commands.description: Join a cluster and show the member table and key  placement.
